release_notes: Build 98 fixes duplicate Quiz History path repair so one unresolved row no longer blocks every safe repair in the same shared C: project folder.
The repair no longer guesses which History row owns a duplicated C: folder. Each affected row is independently matched only to a unique High-confidence alternate C: or Z: project folder.
Safe rows can now be repaired while ambiguous or unmatched siblings remain unchanged for a later scan.
Alternate destination folders remain strictly one-to-one: the same physical project folder cannot be assigned automatically to two Quiz History rows.
Build 97's episode safety remains enforced: contradictory explicit or trusted trailing episode numbers are rejected as No match, including Logos - 001 versus episode #003.
Shared duplicate C: folders themselves are excluded as repair destinations, and paths already owned by non-duplicate History rows remain reserved.
The final apply step rechecks the destination, current stored path, confidence and ownership before updating Quiz History.
Duplicate-path repair is still database-only. It does not move, copy, rename, overwrite or delete any C: or Z: files.
Regression tests cover partial sibling repair, one-destination-per-row enforcement, multiple distinct repairs from one shared path, and the episode conflict guards.
